message.content:
Here are a few ways you can stay up‑to‑date with the latest sports news:

| Platform | What it offers | How to use it |
|----------|----------------|---------------|
| **Sports news websites** (ESPN, BBC Sport, Sky Sports, CBS Sports) | Live updates, breaking stories, in‑depth analysis | Visit the site’s “Live” or “Breaking” section; subscribe to email alerts. |
| **News aggregators** (Google News, Apple News, Flipboard) | Customizable feeds, push notifications | Search for “sports” or specific leagues/teams; enable notifications. |
| **Social media** (Twitter, Reddit, Instagram) | Real‑time commentary, fan reactions | Follow official team accounts, league handles, and popular sports journalists. |
| **Mobile apps** (ESPN, Bleacher Report, Yahoo Sports, TheScore) | Push alerts, live scores, video highlights | Download the app, set preferences for teams/leagues, enable notifications. |
| **Podcasts & YouTube** (ESPN Podcast, The Bill Simmons Podcast, SportsCenter) | Audio/visual recap, expert interviews | Subscribe to podcasts or channels; set auto‑play for new episodes. |
| **RSS feeds** | Direct updates to your reader | Add feeds like `https://www.espn.com/espn/rss/news` to an RSS reader. |

**Quick start:**  
1. Install the ESPN or TheScore app on your phone.  
2. Sign in and add your favorite teams/leagues.  
3. Turn on push notifications for “Breaking News” and “Live Scores.”  

That will give you instant alerts whenever something big happens. Let me know if you’d like help setting up any of these options!
